131: 			throw new NullPointerException(
132: 					"The source and/or destination image is null."
133: 			);
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: 	
137: 	/**
138: 	 * Returns the rendering hints that the resizer uses.
139: 	 * <p>
140: 	 * The keys and values used for the rendering hints are those defined in
141: 	 * the {@link RenderingHints} class.
142: 	 * 
143: 	 * @see RenderingHints
144: 	 * @return		Rendering hints used when resizing the image.
145: 	 */
146: 	public Map<RenderingHints.Key, Object> getRenderingHints() {
147: 		return UNMODIFIABLE_RENDERING_HINTS;
148: 	}
149: }
